tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page ground. Dusk is the primary theme: the console lives at evening.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, the app header.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Hover rows, popovers, inputs, the selected lane.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline borders and dividers on surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Input and control borders; 3:1 on surface in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on bg, surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, metadata, repo names on bg, surface and surface-raised (above 4.5:1 in both themes).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Links, selected nav, active tab underline; readable as text on surface in both themes.

tokens.name: sky-violet
tokens.usage: Brand. Start of the sky gradient in the mark and hero. A fill or large mark only, never body text on bg.

tokens.name: sky-cyan
tokens.usage: Brand. End of the sky gradient; the colour of the machine at work (AI glow, running pulses). AI line colour; day uses signal-running.

tokens.name: mesa
tokens.usage: Brand rock colour from the mark's cliff face. Illustration, cover, charts. Not for text.

tokens.name: mesa-deep
tokens.usage: Shadow face of the mesa. Illustration depth, the dark band of the cover.

tokens.name: sun
tokens.usage: Sunlight on the caprock: the one colour that means a person is needed. Primary button fill, the needs-you signal. Text on it is on-sun.

tokens.name: sun-glow
tokens.usage: Caprock highlight; soft halo around needs-you items. Fill only.

tokens.name: on-sun
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a sun or sun-glow fill (10:1).

tokens.name: signal-running
tokens.usage: Status text and dot: an agent is working (build, review). On surface in both themes.

tokens.name: signal-needs-you
tokens.usage: Status text and dot: waiting on a human decision. Always with the word 'Needs you'.

tokens.name: signal-landed
tokens.usage: Status text and dot: merged to main. Always with the word 'Landed' and a check.

tokens.name: signal-failed
tokens.usage: Status text and dot: a check or build failed. Always with the word 'Failed' and a cross; differs from landed by word and icon, not hue alone.

tokens.name: signal-queued
tokens.usage: Status text and dot: ready, waiting for a lane.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset. Over 3:1 on bg and surface in both themes.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent fill; at least 4.5:1 in both themes.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Hovered accent controls and links.

tokens.name: surface-hover
tokens.usage: Hovered rows and interactive surfaces.

tokens.name: line-soft
tokens.usage: Subtle decorative dividers; not control boundaries.

tokens.name: signal-warn
tokens.usage: Amber warning; sun is needs-you only. Warn always carries a word or icon.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: 16 percent accent over surface; soft status or selection fill.

tokens.name: running-soft
tokens.usage: 16 percent signal-running over surface; soft status or selection fill.

tokens.name: landed-soft
tokens.usage: 16 percent signal-landed over surface; soft status or selection fill.

tokens.name: failed-soft
tokens.usage: 16 percent signal-failed over surface; soft status or selection fill.

tokens.name: warn-soft
tokens.usage: 16 percent signal-warn over surface; soft status or selection fill.

tokens.name: track
tokens.usage: Unfilled track ground in the sim.

tokens.name: ribbon
tokens.usage: Sim summary ribbon ground.

tokens.name: tip-bg
tokens.usage: Tooltip background.

tokens.name: tip-ink
tokens.usage: Tooltip text and icons.

tokens.name: hatch-ground
tokens.usage: Forecast hatch ground; matches surface-raised.

tokens.name: hatch-ink
tokens.usage: Forecast hatch stroke; matches line-strong.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Landing hero slogan only, once per page. Instrument Serif, with the last word in italic. Everything else stays in the sans faces.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Review the proposed change to the merge rules.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Buttons, tabs, form labels, status chips.

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: Item ids, repo paths, branch names, durations.

familyUsage.display: Bricolage Grotesque: landing and marketing only.
familyUsage.body: Instrument Sans: app headings and body.
familyUsage.mono: JetBrains Mono: numbers, ids and durations.
familyUsage.serif: Instrument Serif: sim and preview hero only.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text gap inside chips.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between inline controls; chip padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Row padding in lists; button vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding; page gutter on phones.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between cards; panel padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between app sections.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Landing block padding.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Landing section gap.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Landing hero top and bottom.

tokens.name: radius-s
tokens.usage: Chips, inputs, small buttons.

tokens.name: radius-m
tokens.usage: Buttons, menus.

tokens.name: radius-l
tokens.usage: Cards and panels.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Feature tiles; matches the mark's tile (12 on 40).

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Status dots, toggles.

shadow.note: Shadows are tinted with mesa-deep, never grey: depth reads as dusk light.

tokens.name: shadow-facet
tokens.usage: Cards and panels at rest.

tokens.name: shadow-lift
tokens.usage: Hovered or dragged card; popovers.

tokens.name: shadow-ai
tokens.usage: Glow on an element an agent is working on right now.

tokens.name: shadow-sun
tokens.usage: Glow on the one item that needs a person.

hatch.usage: Forecast or future only. Never animated, never progress.
